## Summary

Describe the user problem and the observable change. Avoid implementation-only summaries.

## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] Ran the relevant package tests.
- [ ] Ran `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build` (or explained why a check could not run).
- [ ] Updated generated schemas and documentation where applicable.

## Architecture and safety

- [ ] Reviewed relevant ADRs and the divergence log.
- [ ] No undocumented change to authority, permissions, execution, or data access.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data, or confidential material added.
- [ ] Breaking changes and unresolved limitations are stated explicitly.

## Evidence

Include test commands, results, relevant issue links, and any remaining risks.
